svg.aria-label: A Winamp-style player. Its clock counts how long you have been on the page and its display says: thanks for stopping by, 4 projects out, more on the way, bugs or ideas? say hi on discord.

g.text: *** thanks for stopping by *** that clock is how long you've been here *** 4 projects out, more on the way *** bugs or ideas? say hi on discord
